questions.q_en: Who was the Registrar General & Census Commissioner during the Census 2011?
questions.solution_en:
• C. Chandramouli was the Census Commissioner in 2011.

• H. S. Brahma was Chief Election Commissioner, not Census Commissioner.

• Nirvachan Sahu was a state-level officer.

• T. N. Seshan is a former Chief Election Commissioner.

Further Insight:

• Census is a process of collecting, compiling, analyzing, and disseminating demographic, social, and economic data.

• Frequency: Conducted every 10 years; began in 1871.

• Census 2011: The 15th National Census of India and the 7th since Independence.

• Motto: "Our Census, Our Future."

• Conducted by: Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (C. Chandramouli).

• Data Release: March 31, 2011.
questions.solution_hi:

questions.q_en: Which state had the highest fertility rate as of Census 2011?
questions.solution_en:
• According to the 2011 census, Bihar had the highest fertility rate in India, with a total fertility rate (TFR) of 3.4.

Further Insight:

• The TFR is the number of children a woman would have if she were to live to the end of her childbearing years.

• A TFR of 2.1 is considered the replacement rate, which ensures a stable population

• 2011 की जनगणना के अनुसार, बिहार में भारत में सबसे अधिक प्रजनन दर थी, कुल प्रजनन दर (TFR) 3.4 के साथ।

• TFR वह बच्चों की संख्या है जो एक महिला को होगी यदि वह अपने प्रजनन वर्षों के अंत तक जीवित रहे।
